name: Himenogawa Kotora
source:
Kotora is a very cute girl and has her trademark bow  (which reminds people of a rabbit). She is quite athletic and her smile can really brighten people’s moods. She’s [url=/c703]Kanaka's[/url] cousin and they used to play together when they were younger. Although she looks quite innocent, apparently when she’s angry, she is like a tiger.

[edited from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/05/31/preview-diamic-days/]Liemyx's blog[/url]]
